input.quote: c. the amount of any other actual direct damages, up to the greater of $100,000 or the charges paid by Customer to IBM for the Services in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the accrual of the first claim related to the Services.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual and set at 12 months' charges (Sections 9.1(c)/9.2(c)), and indemnification and bodily-injury claims already sit outside it, but it deviates from our preferred position in three respects: (i) the fixed floor is $100,000 rather than USD 1,000,000 and is measured on charges "paid" only rather than "paid or payable"; (ii) there are no carve-outs for breach of confidentiality/data protection and security obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or infringement of the other party's IP; and (iii) Section 9.1(2) wholly excludes IBM liability for loss of or damage to Customer's records or data — a one-sided exclusion that guts our remedy in a hosting deal. The mutual consequential-damages exclusion in Section 10 with its carve-out for Customer's payment obligations is acceptable. Redline raises the floor on both sides, adds a mutual Excluded Claims provision, and deletes the data-loss exclusion.

proposal.summary: Raise mutual cap floor to $1,000,000 on fees paid or payable, add uncapped Excluded Claims, delete IBM's data-loss exclusion
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' charges (paid or payable) and USD 1,000,000, so we raised the $100,000 floor on both sides and removed IBM's blanket exclusion of liability for loss of Customer records or data, which is unacceptable in a hosting arrangement. We also confirmed that indemnification, confidentiality/data protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap; if needed we can fall back to a straight twelve months' charges cap with those carve-outs retained.

ops.text: 9.3 Excluded Claims. The limitations in Sections 9.1 and 9.2 do not apply to Excluded Claims, for which each party remains fully liable. "Excluded Claims" means a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations under Section 8, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights. Customer's obligation to pay amounts owing under this Agreement is not subject to the limitations in Sections 9.1, 9.2 or 10.
